# Mexico Online Genealogy Records



[Mexico](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Genealogy "Mexico Genealogy")

Online Genealogy Records

|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| These are genealogy links to Mexico online databases and indexes that may include birth records, marriage records, death records, biographies, cemeteries, censuses, histories, immigration records, land records, military records, newspapers, obituaries, or probate records. Some subscription websites listed below can be searched for free at a **[FamilySearch center or FamilySearch affiliate library.](https://www.familysearch.org/fhcenters/locations/)** | | | | | |
| **Births, Marriages, and Deaths: [Church Records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Church_Records "Mexico Church Records") and [Civil Registration](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Civil_Registration "Mexico Civil Registration")**   ---   ***Births***   * **1560-1950**: [Mexico Baptisms](https://www.familysearch.org/search/collection/1473011) at FamilySearch — [How to Use this Collection](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Baptisms_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Baptisms - FamilySearch Historical Records"); index only;   *Also at [Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/9297)* ($); *Also at [MyHeritage](http://www.myheritage.com/research/collection-30039/mexico-baptisms-1560-1950?s=218489221)* ($); Due to changes in contracts with record custodians, the availability of some FamilySearch record collections may change over time.

This website requires a paid subscription for full access. Some subscription websites are available for free at your local [FamilySearch Center or Affiliate Library](https://www.familysearch.org/centers/locations/).
